name: Surveyor 5
about: Surveyor 5 (1967-084A, NASA/JPL), launched 1967 Sep  8. Its phases from GCAT: Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
GCAT gives a straight-in path to the ground, periapsis below the surface
